items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Complete AI chat block for AI SDK useChat: a MessageScroller transcript that follows streamed output and anchors each user turn, an Empty state with one-click Suggestions, user text in Bubbles, assistant parts rendered as Message Response (Streamdown markdown), Reasoning (collapsible thinking), Tool (tool-* and dynamic-tool calls with input and output) and file parts as Attachments, a shimmering Marker while a request is pending, and a Prompt Input composer with attachments and a submit button that becomes stop while streaming. Ships as a composable Chat component (plus ChatMessages, ChatMessage, ChatMessagePart, ChatToolPart, ChatAttachments, ChatEmpty, ChatThinkingMarker, ChatComposer exports), a scripted demo conversation built with @shadcn/helpers createChat that streams with no API key, and an app/chat page that wires them together. Use it to start a chatbot, assistant or agent UI, then replace the demo transport with your own route.
items.docs: The page installs at app/chat/page.tsx and streams a scripted conversation through @shadcn/helpers, so it works without an API key. To connect a model, replace `transport` in the page with `new DefaultChatTransport({ api: "/api/chat" })` from `ai` and add a route that returns `result.toUIMessageStreamResponse()`. Chat fills its parent: render it inside a height-constrained container (the page uses h-svh). Suggestions are submitted as-is when clicked. Streamdown needs `@source "../node_modules/streamdown/dist/*.js"` in your globals.css (see @uifiles/response).
